summary: Fusion Fuel Green PLC filed a Form 6-K detailing three interest-free, unsecured loan agreements with ILUS (and related extensions) under a prior Stock Purchase Agreement. Fusion Fuel lent ILUS $100,000 (Dec 2025), $240,000 (Feb 2026), and $240,000 (Mar 2026, inferred) in exchange for ILUS extending the Extended Purchaser Meeting Deadline to March 31, 2026. Repayment is due upon first anniversary, preferred-share conversion, or ILUS ceasing to hold shares; Fusion Fuel can settle by share cancellation. Watch for shareholder-approval status and potential repurchase obligations.
